durationRange: Choose a duration of up to a day.
dueDateForTime: Choose a due date for the due time.
dueTimeForDuration: Choose a due time for the duration.
dueDateForRepeat: Choose a due date to repeat from.
repeatEndAfterDue: Choose a repeat end on or after the due date.
repeatOffered: Choose a repeat the picker offers.

validInstant.due: Choose a valid due date and time.
validInstant.transaction: Choose a valid transaction date and time.
validInstant.reminder: Choose a valid reminder date and time.

unavailableInstant.due: This local time is unavailable. Choose another due time.
unavailableInstant.transaction: This local time is unavailable. Choose another transaction time.
unavailableInstant.reminder: This local time is unavailable. Choose another reminder time.

transactionInstant: Choose a transaction date and time.
reminderInstant: Choose a reminder date and time.
validDateTime: Enter a valid date and time (HH:mm).
clockChange: This local time does not exist because the clock changes. Choose another time.
endBeforeStartDate: End date must not precede start date.
endAndTime: Provide both an end date and time, or leave both empty.
endBeforeStartTime: End time must not precede start time.
